verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy is still married to Erica Stoll.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Stoll and McIlroy have been married since 2017... A month later she’d withdraw the petition.'; R2: 'McIlroy has been married to... Erica Stoll since April 22, 2017.'; R5: 'Erica Stoll, who is married to Masters Champion Rory McIlroy'; R6: 'his wife, Erica Stoll'; R7: 'Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll got married in 2017... the couple reconciled a month later'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm ongoing marriage post-reconciliation, referring to her as wife in 2026 contexts.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy filed for divorce in May 2024.
verifications.label: AMBIGUOUS
verifications.evidence: R1: 'she filed for divorce in May of 2024'; R2: 'McIlroy filed for divorce in 2024'; R3: 'the divorce petition he filed in a Florida court last month'; R4: 'McIlroy filed for divorce from Stoll'; R7: 'McIlroy filed for divorce from Stoll on May 13, 2024'
verifications.reasoning: Most sources state Rory filed, but R1 explicitly states Erica filed, creating contradiction.

verifications.claim: Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll announced one month later that they had reconciled and decided to call off the divorce, choosing to continue their marriage and "move forward as a family".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'withdrew that petition, telling the Guardian "Erica and I have realized that our best future was as a family together....Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning."'; R3: '"Over the past weeks, Erica and I have realised that our best future was as a family together. Thankfully, we have resolved our differences and look forward to a new beginning."'; R7: 'called it off one month later'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly support reconciliation announcement ~1 month after May 2024 filing (June 2024), with near-identical quotes emphasizing family togetherness.

verifications.claim: In June 2024, it was reported that a motion was filed to voluntarily dismiss the divorce petition.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'court papers served in Florida on Tuesday show dismissal of the case at the behest of the parties involved' (article dated Jun 11, 2024); R7: 'on June 11, 2024, his attorney filed a notice of voluntary dismissal in Palm Beach County Court'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly report voluntary dismissal filing in June 2024.
